blocks.html: Notwithstanding Section 1208.2, all habitable rooms in basements shall have a minimum clear ceiling height of 7 feet (2.1 meters). The minimum clear ceiling height of all habitable rooms in a cellar shall be 7 feet (2.1 meters).
